sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: A tiny scar, bloodshot eyes and sagging jowls – it is the intimate details of these 15th-century masterpieces that make them so relatable today The word “human” may have been crowned the Cambridge dictionary’s word of 2026 , but its meaning is nowhere more manifest than in an exhibition of paintings from almost 600 years ago. Humanness is captured in every pore and wrinkle of all nine of Jan van Eyck ’s portraits, united for the first time by the National Gallery. The paintings have been loaned from Berlin, Vienna, Dresden, Bruges and Sibiu in Romania, in a triumph of cultural exchange that proves the blockbuster show is still very much alive. And so, it almost seems, are the people depicted in it, who appear so real we might “recognise them on the tube”, as the exhibition’s co-curator Nicholas Flory put it , even given their extravagant headgear. A purplish wart, a tiny scar, bloodshot eyes, sagging jowls and dirty fingernails – it is the intimate details of Van Eyck’s likenesses that transformed Renaissance portraiture and make his sitters so relatable, in modern parlance, today. Like a novelist, the artist wanted to create the impression of capturing his subjects in a moment in time. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? sources.summary: 九合一選戰倒數，台北市長蔣萬安昨（20）晚跟妻子石舫亘合體，士林夜市對面發放「光榮台北」明信片；不過發放過程有一對夏莉絲幼托機構涉兒虐案的家長，當場下跪陳情，請市長協助處理退費問題，蔣萬安承諾會來處理。至於民進黨候選人沈伯洋，昨日下午到台中，合體何欣純車掃，晚間則出席在烏日的聯合造勢晚會。
sources.title: 蔣萬安發「光榮台北」明信片 沈伯洋赴台中合體何欣純造勢

claim_trace.claim: 台北市長蔣萬安11月20日晚間與妻子石舫亘在士林夜市對面發放「光榮台北」明信片，過程中一對涉幼托機構兒虐案家長下跪陳情，蔣萬安承諾處理；民進黨候選人沈伯洋同日赴台中與何欣純車掃，晚間出席烏日造勢晚會。
